breakdown.description: The prompt lets the bar undergo the free thermal strain even though the problem states the total change in length is constrained to zero by rigid supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly enforces the fully restrained condition (total strain = zero), stating 'the mechanical strain is equal and opposite to the free thermal strain: ε_mechanical = −α × ΔT.' It does not allow the bar to undergo free thermal strain as the incomplete prompt incorrectly suggested.

breakdown.description: The prompt makes the thermal stress vanish under full axial restraint, but full restraint is exactly what generates the thermal stress in this problem.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly computes a non-zero thermal stress under full axial restraint: σ = −E × α × ΔT = −200 MPa (compressive). It does not make the thermal stress vanish, directly contradicting the flawed instruction in the incomplete prompt and aligning with the ground truth.
